method: Single representative ERA5-Land 0.1-degree model-grid cell per destination, matching the published batch-1 method. Centroids are placed on established hiking terrain rather than on summits, glaciers or open water, so the nearest model cell represents walkable ground. No polygon, DEM profile or elevation-band decision is required by this path; the band is derived as the resolved model elevation plus or minus 50 m.
gates: Every candidate still passes the existing automated gates before publication: ERA5-Land invariant-orography resolution, the 10 m glacier snow-depth sentinel, the twelve-month persistent-snow hold, and the unrounded <=20 critical-component recommendation rule. Candidates that fail are withheld, not softened.
